entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-26
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • dotnet format reports warning when project output dlls are not present #51932
  • .NET10 WPF: C# 8.0 'using' declarations behave differently than its try/final equivalent (assembly reference issue) #51931
  • Confusing error when non .NET sdk has no compatible targets #51930
  • Revise `CreateFromFilteredSolutionFile` implementation for trailing comma (and allowing comments) #51929
  • Dynamic code execution on Ubuntu 24.04 #51928
  • Add short-form -v example to .NET CLI global options documentation #51926
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/9.0.3xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #51923
  • `dotnet-tools.json` should include `rollForward` in its schema #51922

Closed

  • Add sample or clarification for cross-platform behavior of [feature/area] #51927
  • [dotnet watch publish] command with -fileLogger switch is broken after updating Visual Studio 2022 from 17.5.3 to 17.9.6 #40841
  • Scripted installs of .NET 10 SDK using dotnet-install.ps1 for x64 no longer include other platforms of the Microsoft.NETCore.App.Host packs #51840
  • sdk repo referencing stale 10.x versions? #51813
  • AdmH #51810
